create_flopmeasure_context_manager: create a FlopMeasure context manager to count flops for a PyTorch model with warmup steps
run_flop_counting_with_warmup: run flop counting on a model using FlopMeasure with configurable warmup steps before measurement starts
get_total_flops: get the total number of floating point operations counted by the FlopMeasure instance
get_flops_per_sec: get the flops per second throughput from a FlopMeasure instance after counting completes
get_flop_table: get a hierarchical table of flop counts per module from the FlopMeasure instance
